subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the underlined group of words.

The soldier struck the enemy with the __short sword fixed onto the end of the gun__.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"baron"** refers to a member of the lowest order of the British nobility or a person of great power in a particular area of business. (बैरन)

 
 
• **Example: **The oil baron owned several refineries and was one of the wealthiest men in the country.
 
 
 
• **"Bayonet"** refers to a blade that may be fixed to the muzzle of a rifle and used to stab an opponent in hand-to-hand fighting. (बायोनेट)
 
 
• **Example: **The soldier fixed his bayonet to the end of his rifle before charging at the enemy.
 
 
 
• Hence, the correct word "bayonet" means a blade fixed to the end of a gun. (बायोनेट)
 
 
• **Example: **The soldier struck the enemy with the bayonet.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Baron** (बैरन): A member of the lowest order of the British nobility or a powerful person in a particular business.

 
 
• **Example:** The media baron owns several television networks.
 
 
 
• **Bigot** (कट्टरपंथी): A person who is intolerant towards those holding different opinions.
 
 
• **Example:** She refused to listen to his ideas because she is a bigot.
 
 
 
• **Baton** (लाठी): A short stick or staff used by police officers, conductors, or in relay races.
 
 
• **Example:** The conductor used his baton to lead the orchestra.
